description: Na₂Ca₄ZrNbSi₄O₁₇F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.89 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.84 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.76 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₅F octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NbO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.46 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.89 Å. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O and one F atom to form distorted CaO₆F hexagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₅F octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and edges with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.70 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.31 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₅F octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CaO₆F hexagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 35°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.19 Å. Nb is bonded to five O and one F atom to form NbO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-48°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.21 Å. The Nb-F bond length is 2.15 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-50°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NbO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-71°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-43°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F hexagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NbO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-56°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. There are seventeen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂CaNb trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ca atoms to form ONa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂CaNb trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one FNa₂CaNb trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Nb atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ca and one Si atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂CaNb trigonal pyramid. F is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one Nb atom to form distorted FNa₂CaNb trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra.
